blurb: Guests rent from a fleet of canoes, kayaks, and stand up paddle boards for peaceful flat-water exploration down the Ipswich River and wildlife reserve. Rentals include paddles, life jackets, and local river maps with safety tips. A dedicated shuttle service provides upstream drop-offs and returns guests to the main facility.
